overall_summary: Data shows that broader family and domestic relationship topics (especially husband-wife dynamics) significantly outperform niche shayari or generic relationship advice, drawing over 10x more views. However, sample size is limited, so we lean towards proven domestic relationship themes while using a small experiment.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,766 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,671 views) heavily outperformed all other content.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on marital and domestic partnership emotional struggles.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 12 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly poetic or abstract heartbreak lines; stick to grounded, everyday emotional scenarios.

next_video.twist_direction: The realization that the biggest distance isn't physical, it's the silence built over small unsaid apologies.
